name: ICICI Pru iProtect Smart
description: A comprehensive term insurance plan offering life cover, terminal illness coverage, and optional riders for critical illness and accidental death.
key_benefits: Life cover up to 99 years of age

name: ICICI Pru Signature
description: A Unit Linked Insurance Plan that provides life cover and helps in wealth creation through investments in equity and debt funds without any premium allocation or policy administration charges.
key_benefits: Return of mortality charges at maturity

name: ICICI Pru Guaranteed Wealth Protector
description: A traditional life insurance plan that offers guaranteed maturity benefits along with life cover, ensuring your savings are protected from market volatility.
key_benefits: Life cover equal to 10 times the annual premium

name: ICICI Pru Easy Retirement
description: A unit-linked pension plan that helps you build a retirement corpus by investing in equity and debt, with a capital guarantee feature to protect against market downturns.
key_benefits: Assured benefit on maturity or death

name: ICICI Pru Smart Kid
description: A child education plan designed to secure your childs future even in your absence, offering a lump sum payout on death and funding future premiums.
key_benefits: Waiver of premium benefit on death or disability

name: ICICI Pru Gold
description: A participating savings plan designed to provide a lifelong guaranteed regular income starting right from the end of the premium payment term.
key_benefits: Life cover for the entire policy term

name: ICICI Pru Heart / Cancer Protect
description: A specialized health insurance plan that provides a lump sum payout on the diagnosis of minor or major conditions of Heart Disease or Cancer.
key_benefits: Lump sum payout on diagnosis irrespective of actual medical costs
Waiver of premium on diagnosis of minor condition
